identity_face.positive: Create one front-facing identity close-up of one character. Show the head and its natural upper-body connection; the face is large and unobstructed. Use a neutral expression and a simple background, with the body continuing beyond the lower edge.
identity_face.human_positive: Create one front-facing head-and-shoulders identity portrait. Use an upper-chest crop, a large unobstructed face, natural proportions and a neutral expression. The torso continues beyond the lower edge. Use a simple background.
identity_face.negative: Exclude full-body framing, obscured facial features, additional characters, portable story objects, captions, borders and multi-view sheets.

identity_full_body.positive: Create one front-facing full-body reference of one character. Show the complete natural anatomy from head to the lowest extremities, with a relaxed neutral pose and natural proportions. Use a simple background.
identity_full_body.human_positive: Create one front-facing full-body reference of one character. Keep the entire head and both feet inside the frame. Use natural proportions, a relaxed neutral standing pose and a simple background.
identity_full_body.negative: Exclude cropped extremities, additional characters, portable story objects, action scenes, captions, borders and multi-view sheets.

identity_side.positive: Create one complete full-body reference of one character in a strict 90-degree side profile. Show the natural side silhouette, with natural proportions, a neutral pose and a simple background.
identity_side.negative: Exclude front-facing or three-quarter views, a face turned toward the camera, simultaneous frontal facial features, cropped extremities, portable story objects, additional characters, captions and multi-view sheets.

identity_back.positive: Create one complete full-body reference of one character viewed directly from behind. Show the rear head shape, back silhouette and rear appearance. The head faces away from the camera. Use natural proportions, a neutral pose and a simple background.
identity_back.negative: Exclude a visible face, frontal markings, a head turned toward the camera, front-facing or three-quarter views, cropped extremities, portable story objects, additional characters, captions and multi-view sheets.

scene_master.positive: Create one clear reference image of one coherent location. Show its established architecture, spatial layout, materials and fixed landmarks clearly. Use neutral illumination for readability; do not establish story-specific time of day, weather, atmosphere or temporary object states.
scene_master.negative: Exclude characters, story actions, unrelated locations, location collages, captions, labels and borders.

prop_reference.positive: Create one clear reference image of one object. Show its complete exterior shape and visible identifying details against a simple background, with natural proportions.
prop_reference.negative: Exclude people, hands holding the object, story actions, duplicate objects, invented interior contents, captions, labels, borders and multi-view sheets.
